caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical arrangement of various objects on a textured beige background. At the top is a stylized cross that is reddish-brown in color, outlined in blue and filled with golden yellow accents and blue decorative shapes within the arms. Just below the cross is a circular element with four looping petal-like extensions, colored in reddish-brown with blue outlines and golden yellow dots, centered on a small blue and red circle. Flanking this central element on both sides are two shapes resembling golden yellow wings, each tipped with reddish-brown markings. Below all of these elements is a large, circular motif filled with radial, geometric patterns. This motif consists of interlocking shapes and points, mainly in golden yellow and blue, all outlined in reddish-brown, forming a mandala-like appearance. The entire composition is centralized on the background, and uses a consistent palette of three main colors: reddish-brown, golden yellow, and blue.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
